as_told.title: Beings unmasked looked like the Peruvian mummies

plain: Deep Prasad is a researcher who appears on the podcast of host Jesse Michels. He says that one night he suddenly could no longer move. He noticed a shimmering object and moved his eyes left and right, hoping it would go away. When he looked back, it had fully appeared, with beautiful golden symbols dancing at its center. As soon as it touched him, he says, he got a true download, a sudden rush of knowledge. In other tellings on the same episode, he places it in 2019 in a 30th-floor apartment in Toronto. There he describes a visor that turned out to belong to a whole face, suit and helmet, and says that when the beings were unmasked they looked like the Peruvian mummies, small mummified bodies from Peru that some say are not human. If true, it would mean beings visited him and passed knowledge straight into his mind. All the tellings are his own, and they differ on whether he saw golden symbols or a being in a suit.
